description: Sort 2 to 10 funds by up to three published facts: ongoing charge, US share, pairwise overlap and holdings count. Rows follow the criteria in order. A missing fact sorts last and stays null; it is never estimated. Rates are decimal fractions (0.07 = 7%). Analysis based on published fund data. Returns checkUrl: a shareable link to the same result.

items.description: ISIN with a valid check digit.
